findings.question: Does the official marketplace pin the revision we locked?

findings.answer: No. Every gate is prose the model may skip, and it ships no machine gate — finishing-a-development-branch runs the local suite and then presents a human menu.
findings.question: Does it enforce any stage boundary?

findings.answer: No. It is a plugin for those harnesses. Agents behind a raw OpenAI-compatible endpoint get nothing unless the skill text is injected by the caller, which is what WP-021 now does.
findings.question: Does it reach agents that are not Claude Code, Codex or Hermes?

findings.answer: The SessionStart hook matches startup|clear|compact and re-injects the bootstrap; an SDD ledger with machine-parseable lines carries progress. Codex ships hooks:{} and has neither.
